messages:
nina (docs): quick pass on the hello-mini quickstart — need to update auth snippet for SDK v7. opened a small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8423

sam (devex): thanks. can you paste the before/after snippets here? i'll skim

nina (docs): sure — old:
```
const client = new RedwoodClient(process.env.API_KEY)
const resp = await client.generate({ prompt })
```
new:
```
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const resp = await client.text.generate({ input: prompt })
```
notes: renamed API surface to .text.generate and prefer explicit apiKey arg. also call out using env var REDWOOD_API_KEY in quickstart

mike (eng-sdk): that looks right. one minor: we should prefer `REDWOOD_API_KEY` vs `API_KEY` in examples. also ensure TypeScript example imports `Redwood` default export

laura (qa): i'll run the example in the container image (linux x86) and report any runtime errors

nina (docs): updated Dockerfile snippet in PR to show ARG and `ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY` with `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=...`

jen (product): wording suggestion: change "set your key" to "configure your REDWOOD_API_KEY secret" for clarity

sam (devex): small extra: add a one-liner for using secrets in GH actions — `- name: Set REDWOOD_API_KEY
  run: echo "REDWOOD_API_KEY=${{ secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV`

mike (eng-sdk): @nina can you adjust the TypeScript snippet? I'll review after

nina (docs): done — pushed another commit. added TS import + small typings note

deploy-bot: preview deployed — https://deploy-preview-8423--docs.redwood.inference

laura (qa): smoke passed. found a flake in async example (missing await) — pushed patch to PR

nina (docs): fixed the await, reworded the auth paragraph per jen's suggestion

sam (devex): :eyes: running quick lint and linkcheck now

laura (qa): linkcheck OK, samples run OK on M1 and x86. no perf regressions

sam (devex): looks good to me. merging once CI green

nina (docs): thanks all — will follow up with a short migration note for existing quickstarts to watch for .text vs .generate naming

mike (eng-sdk): happy to add a micro changelog entry if you want

nina (docs): yes please — add under "SDK changes" in the PR. will ship after CI :shipit:
